lead.headline: Tesla has 43 California accident inspections by job-safety regulators; 18 are still open, with a median 486 days to close
lead.number: Tesla: 44 accident or fatality inspections since 2015, 43 in California; 18 still open; median 486 days to close vs 139-251 for most top employers.
lead.watch_out: California files serious-injury inspections as type A where other states use M, and there's no headcount.
